bull_case: Owner FCF/share keeps compounding as AI and VMware scale on an asset-light base. TTM R&D plus capex absorbs about one-third of OCF while operating income and cash generation rise much faster than invested capital.
bear_case: Reported OCF benefits from $3.95B of 9M receivables factoring, SBC remains large, and future AI rack/purchase commitments make growth more capital intensive than historical capex suggests. Current incremental returns may therefore overstate steady-state economics.
thesis: Reinvestment economics are strong enough for Growth but not clean enough for a 90. A simple invested-capital bridge is consistent with very high incremental returns, TTM internal reinvestment absorption is about 32%, and owner-FCF/share has risen sharply. Factoring, SBC and AI commitments justify conservative normalization.

evidence.claim: TTM R&D is estimated at $11.836B from FY2025 $10.977B + 9M FY2026 $8.855B - 9M FY2025 $7.996B.
evidence.source: User-supplied FY2025 Annual Report and Q3 FY2026 10-Q

evidence.claim: TTM capex is about $1.250B and TTM OCF about $40.653B; (capex + R&D)/OCF is therefore approximately 32.2%.
evidence.source: User-supplied FY2025 Annual Report and 2025/2026 Q3 10-Qs; arithmetic

evidence.claim: Owner-FCF proxy (OCF-capex-SBC) rises from about $19.346B/$3.99 per diluted share in FY2025 to about $30.921B/$6.33 per Q3 diluted share on a TTM basis.
evidence.source: User-supplied FY2025 Annual Report and Q3 FY2026 10-Q; arithmetic

evidence.claim: A simple invested-capital proxy (debt + equity - cash) increased from about $130.25B at FY2025 year-end to $135.13B at 2026-08-02, while TTM operating income is estimated near $42.81B versus FY2025 $25.48B. The bridge is directionally inconsistent with ROIC collapse, though acquisition accounting limits precision.
evidence.source: User-supplied FY2025 Annual Report and Q3 FY2026 10-Q; arithmetic

evidence.claim: Broadcom sold $3.950B of trade receivables under non-recourse factoring arrangements during 9M FY2026, which accelerates reported operating cash collection.
Q3 diluted weighted-average shares were 4.887B versus 4.860B a year earlier (+0.56%) while 9M stock repurchases were $8.450B.

counterevidence: The invested-capital bridge is distorted by acquisition goodwill/intangibles, retained earnings and debt repayment, so it is not a clean project-level incremental ROIC calculation.
TTM owner FCF includes receivables factoring; subtracting the full 9M factoring amount would reduce the current proxy materially, though it remains above FY2025 per share.
SBC remains economically large even though buybacks limit share-count dilution.
$126.8B purchase commitments and XPV support indicate that the next phase of AI growth may require more capital than historical PP&E capex suggests.
unknowns: Project-level returns on custom-XPU NRE/R&D and capacity commitments.
Normalized factoring usage across a full cycle.
falsifiers: Incremental-ROIC score falls if operating profit growth stalls while invested capital and commitments keep rising.
FCF/share quality falls if normalized owner FCF/share drops below FY2025's ~$4 level for two quarters.
Reinvestment-runway score falls if TTM absorption drops below 15% without an offsetting high-return acquisition program.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Diluted shares increased only about 0.56% y/y and 9M repurchases totaled $8.45B. Material SBC exists, but the 'long-lasting and excessive dilution' elements are not supported by the share-count evidence.

Operating income and owner-FCF proxies are rising sharply while a simple invested-capital proxy increased only modestly. The exact incremental ROIC is noisy, but evidence contradicts a structural collapse below cost of capital.

next_checks: Normalize OCF for factoring and working-capital timing each quarter.
Match purchase commitments to non-cancellable customer contracts.
Track project-level XPU NRE/capacity returns where disclosed.

subscores.rationale: Operating income and owner-FCF growth materially exceed the change in a simple invested-capital proxy, consistent with the 75 'superior' anchor. 90 is excluded because VMware accounting and customer-financing commitments prevent a clean project-level ROIC estimate.

TTM internal reinvestment absorption is about 32.2%. Band-centre interpolation within the 15-35% row produces roughly 70 on the 5-point grid, so the configured observable anchor determines this score.

Owner-FCF/share proxy rises from about $3.99 in FY2025 to $6.33 TTM with only 0.56% y/y diluted-share growth. Factoring and SBC prevent a 90 'strong compounding' score but the normalized direction supports 75.

uncertainties.rationale: Acquisition accounting makes the denominator noisy.
Purchase commitments are not captured in conventional capex absorption.
Receivables factoring and SBC materially affect cash-quality interpretation.
